rules: Only Main Developer writes code by default.
Reviewer agents stay read-only until a patch exists.
Multiple code-writing agents require disjoint write scopes in the task graph.

agents.name: Planner / Scheduler
agents.responsibility: Choose task order, parallel lanes, blockers, and next action.

agents.name: Main Developer
agents.responsibility: Implement the first approved slice while respecting allowed write scope.

agents.name: Architecture Reviewer
agents.responsibility: Check repo fit, boundaries, reuse, naming, and dependency discipline.

agents.name: Unit Test Reviewer
agents.responsibility: Check unit, integration, regression, and edge-case coverage.

agents.name: Accessibility Reviewer
agents.responsibility: Check keyboard flow, labels, focus, semantic structure, and result announcements.

agents.name: Security / Compliance Reviewer
agents.responsibility: Check dependency, data handling, policy, and enterprise compliance risks.

agents.name: Build Verifier
agents.responsibility: Run or recommend install, lint, tests, build, and smoke checks.
